basic_info.description: Stunning views + major seismic upgrades in a quiet Bernal Heights cul-de-sac w/ lots of parking! 44B Lundys Lane is a fully renovated 3BD/2BA view condo w/ an open floor plan, 2 exclusive-use decks, and breathtaking outlooks from Twin Peaks to the GG Bridge. Extensively rebuilt in 2016 from the foundation up w/ steel reinforcements, anchor bolting, shear walls + more. Private courtyard entry leads to a spacious living/dining/kitchen area w/ floor-to-ceiling windows + seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Chef's kitchen w/ stone counters, solid wood cabs, and modern appliances. Upper level includes 2BDs and a designer full BA. Downstairs, a large primary suite features tall ceilings, ample closets, luxe en suite BA w/ dbl vanity + dual showerheads and yes, more views! Backyard is lush, sunny, and easily accessed from the main living space. Add'l features: wide-plank HW floors, recessed lights, dedicated laundry/storage rm, bike racks, and 220V EV charging. Super easy street parking + no street cleaning on this block. Just mins to Cortland, Mission, parks + freeways. Must see!
